phase_desc: Above trend, rising. Own equities and commodities.

phases.REBOUND: Below trend, rising. Own equities and credit; cyclical growth (tech, discretionary, financials).
phases.CALM: Above trend, rising. Own equities and commodities.
phases.SPECULATION: Above trend, rolling over. Trim equities, exit credit, rotate to commodities and cyclical value; bonds bear-flatten.
phases.TURBULENCE: Below trend, falling. Cash on the way down, long-duration Treasuries into the trough; defensives lead.
